title: Motion design showreel (16:9)
description: A 15-second abstract motion-design reel in a brand palette: a dot grid ripples and springs into a disc, the disc morphs through shapes on springs and irises open, three words land in turn (masked letter rises, circular kinetic type round a rotating ring, a two-tone mask sweep) with stripe, iris and shutter transitions, and the studio name closes with an impact ring and sprung shapes. A pulse bed with clicks, whooshes, a riser and an impact cued to every beat. Code-rendered (scene.motion-showreel).

word_1.description: First word or two-word phrase, under 16 characters (a quality of the work)

word_2.description: Second word or two-word phrase, under 16 characters

word_3.description: Third word or two-word phrase, under 16 characters

name.description: The studio, brand or designer name exactly as written in the brief, under 24 characters

kicker.description: Small line under the name naming the discipline (e.g. 'Motion design'), under 28 characters; no years, clients or awards the brief does not state

look.description: Palette: studio (black, vermilion, blue, yellow), noir (black, white, one red), acid (black, lime, violet, pink), paper (cream, orange, navy, gold)

energy.description: Music energy for the procedural pulse bed

scene.description: The showreel animation; rendered from the copy unless supplied

music.description: Music bed; produced procedurally unless a cleared track is supplied

whoosh.description: Whoosh on the iris, stripe and ring transitions

copy_examples.brief: Reel for Fold & Form, a paper-craft animation studio. Their work is tactile, playful and precise. Paper look.
copy_examples.note: The name is copied exactly; the three words are the qualities the brief names, one per beat; the kicker names the discipline without adding claims.

style.typography: Inter Black words and name, tracked caps kicker

direction.action: Dots to disc, shape morphs, iris; word 1; stripe wipe; ring type word 2; iris; two-tone mask word 3; shutters; name lockup

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/motion-showreel); the content model supplies the name (verbatim), three words, an optional kicker and two choices.
Words are fitted with measured glyphs (16 characters, two lines at most), the name 24 and the kicker 28; the render fails rather than overflowing. Each word holds 1.6-2 s.

Sound is cued to the recipe's beats at 15 s: clicks on the morphs (frames 72, 90, 108), whooshes on the iris (123), stripe wipe (195) and ring iris (270), a riser through the shutters into the name and an impact as it lands (frame 366).

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -16 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
The studio or brand owner confirms the name, spelling, words and palette are approved, and that the reel does not imply it shows their actual client work.
